snippet.title: Indie Game – Lost Host Official Trailer (Adventure Toy Car Story)
snippet.description:
After a year of development, the Lost Host demo is out on Steam 🚗✨

Lost Host is a new indie game adventure coming in 2026.
This indie adventure game mixes driving mechanics, puzzles, and an emotional story about a toy car searching for its missing owner.
Lost Host is one of the upcoming new indie games arriving in 2026.
Get a first look in this official Lost Host game trailer and add it to your Steam wishlist:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3273260/Lost_Host/

Join our community on Discord: https://discord.gg/Cd3zzMQPuA
Our instagram: https://www.instagram.com/gest.lt/
LinkedIn:  https://www.linkedin.com/company/gest-lt/

Music by: Narvydas Žukauskas
Voiceover by:  Rokas Lukošaitis

👉 Subscribe for more updates!
#LostHost #IndieGame #Steam
